title: Romania retains one of EU’s highest road fatality rates, European Commission report says
summary: Romania recorded 1,296 road deaths in 2025, giving it one of the highest fatality rates in the European Union, according to final figures published by the European Commission on Tuesday, October 27. The total was nevertheless 12% lower than in 2024 and 30% below the 2019 level. With 68 deaths per million inhabitants, Romania remained among the EU’s worst-performing countries alongside Bulgaria, which recorded 71. Croatia also remained among the countries with the highest road mortality rates. At the other end of the ranking, Sweden recorded 19 road deaths per million inhabitants, while Denmark had 24.
